scope: authored CDB evidence, not runtime attack speed or DPS

rules.move_set_selection: nearest nonempty type declaration; runtime overrides are not modeled
rules.skill_resolution: all item/type grants retained with origins; overrides and replacements remain unresolved
rules.timing: raw authored values preserved; missing values are not invented
rules.animation_frames: frame counts and playback fields are not converted to seconds without clip metadata
rules.cadence: skill duration, hit delay and ComboWindow are not assumed to be repeat intervals

WeaponPowerRatio.desc: Percent of AP/SP scaling that are replaced by a flat amount coming from the "base damage" of the weapon
